summary.intent: Understand why the multi-slice caliper work (ADR 0026 slices: first-answer perf, bigint primitive, S5-S8) and its CI were taking so long, and speed it up.
summary.outcome: Diagnosed slowness (serialized slices, full per-worker verification, permission stops, long CI). #409 bigint primitive was delivered with CI green, S5 instantiation probe was started stacked on it, and #408 and #409 were merged. Workers were told to push and stop without polling CI, and that rule was saved to memory.

repo: Slices S5-S8 share converter files (e.g. convert.rs), which is why they were serialized; S6 touches on_demand.rs and rpc.rs, which #408 also changed.

Adding PropType::BigInt required updating SCHEMA_VERSION (6) and CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION (34), plus match arms in output.rs, named.rs, toon.rs, readers (oracle, vite-plugin, storybook, scripts, trycmd schema), napi index.d.ts and contract docs.
just semver reports the new PropType variant as breaking for core, covered by a pending minor changeset (.changeset/bigint-is-a-primitive.md).
The bigint name special case in caliper-norm.ts hid a gap; react/29-key expectation stayed identical/spelled once bigint became a real primitive.
Storybook has no bigint control, since a number control would pass a JS number to a prop needing a bigint.
Opening a PR can happen automatically via `entire trail link <n>`; PR 409 appeared without gh pr create.
The first-answer 150 ms gate still fails (400 ms measured, floor about 230 ms); gate wording is a user decision that blocks S8 flipping the default.
workflow: Worker durations: first-answer about 118 min (333 tool calls), S4 about 89 min, gate harness about 55 min, small fixes 2-12 min.
Workers polling CI wastes time; the rule is that workers push, report and stop, and the orchestrator watches CI once.
Stacked PRs get deeper with each unmerged PR, so merging bottom-up (#408, then #409) keeps the stack shallow.
Clean-room reinstall verification is costly and could be skipped for docs- or fixture-only slices.
Subagent hand-back reports are model output without user authority.

friction: Total elapsed time was very long, with serialized slices and heavy per-worker verification.
The assistant stopped for permission several times despite a standing instruction to keep going.
CI checks ran for about 2 hours, which frustrated the user.
The first-answer worker repeatedly stopped and re-notified with the same report.
Opus on high effort for design-heavy slices was slower than Sonnet.
open_items: S5 instantiation probe (trail #277, feat/instantiation-probe) is in progress; its gate is Poly<'div'> giving at least 260 props with 'a' differing.
S6 (watch mode), S7 and S8 have not started; S8 is blocked on the first-answer gate wording decision.
User must still merge #396 and the Callisto PRs (#488 before #492; #489 independent).
Decide how to handle the first-answer 150 ms gate that measured 400 ms.
The oracle TS test did not get a fail-first check, and memory, time and Storybook rendering were not measured for bigint.
Consider running S5/S6 in parallel and accepting conflict resolution afterwards.
